item.title: 47 Years Later, the Best 'Peanuts' Quote About Life and Death Still Hits Just as Hard
item.description: You can track the evolution of the American comic strip through its typical depiction of childhood. Early 20th century strips like Ernie Bushmiller's Nancy (1933) show kids' lives as relatively prosaic, particularly given the culture and publication standards of the time. While their child protagonists might have faced some incidental frustrations, the comics page was mostly about gentle humor. Yes, Sluggo is a homeless orphan, but no, that isn't a source of angst or conflict.

item.title: CD Projekt Red Will Use AI to Bring Back Geralt’s Original Voice
item.description: In 2019, Jacek Rozenek, the Polish voice actor for Geralt of Rivia in The Witcher games, suffered a stroke that greatly affected his speech. He underwent extensive training to recuperate and regain his ability to act. However, the changes in his voice were still noticeable. To keep the same voice actor in the upcoming DLC Songs of the Past, CD Projekt Red decided to use AI to match his current voice to the original and create the best possible replica.

item.title: 7 Greatest Live-Service Games Killed Before Their Time, Ranked
item.description: At one point or another, most of us have enjoyed a live-service game . Likewise, many of us have been burned when a game publisher decided the revenue no longer justified the ongoing expenses of maintaining an always-on experience. Suddenly, we had nothing to show for our time except memories. It was a bit like paying for tickets to a ballgame, watching the athletes do their thing, and then leaving with a smile. Except with the live-service game, we knew that was the end. We could never go back next year.

item.title: Lord of the Rings Officially Reveals Gollum’s Replacement
item.description: The Lord of the Rings has a lot going for it right now. Next year, The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum is set to release from director Andy Serkis, who brought Gollum to life in Peter Jackson's The Lord of the Rings trilogy as well as the trilogy for The Hobbit . He is, in many ways, the most iconic character in the franchise and is easily the most quoted. You can't talk about Lord of the Rings without someone saying "My precious." Now though, a new character has taken the place of Gollum within the franchise. Meaning a new creature being dragged into things with our main characters.

item.title: 10 Funniest 'Far Side' Comics About Penguins That Prove Gary Larson Is Unbeatable
item.description: Everybody agrees that penguins are funny. They walk funny. They sound funny. They all look like they’re wearing tiny little tuxedos. They’re birds, but they can’t fly — that’s very funny. They live in utterly ridiculous places, and they fall down all the time.

item.title: Clint Eastwood's Legendary Western Sequel Is Waiting to Be Discovered on Streaming
item.description: In 1964, Italian director Sergio Leone redefined the Western movie genre with A Fistful of Dollars . Eschewing the relatively simplistic morality tales of earlier films, Leone’s protagonist wasn’t a noble hero, but an opportunistic gunslinger who pits two rival Old West gangs against each other to score a big payday. Despite the moral complexity of it all — or, more likely, because of it — A Fistful of Dollars was an international success that proved three things: audiences were ready for a new kind of Western, America no longer had a monopoly on the genre, and Clint Eastwood was a bankable movie star.

item.title: What We Know About Every Assassin’s Creed Project in Active Development
item.description: Assassin’s Creed will turn 20 years old in 2027. After 15 main series entries and even more handheld and mobile spinoffs, the series is showing no signs of slowing down. Its latest entry was Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced , a remake of 2013’s Assassin’s Creed 4: Black Flag .

item.title: Queen’s Domain Review: The Perfect Skyrim Replacement for Right Now
item.description: I love Skyrim . I love returning to the spine-tingling haze of ’90s first-person games like Doom , Quake , and Myst . But what I really love is a modern game that feels like a lost relic from that era, not a nostalgic imitation but something that might have actually existed.

item.title: Netflix's Hit Spy Thriller Returns and Takes Over Streaming Charts
item.description: Keira Knightley has a knack for playing smart, determined women who refuse to back down when things get dangerous. Whether she's exposing government secrets in Official Secrets , investigating a serial killer in Boston Strangler , or navigating a deadly mystery aboard a luxury yacht in Netflix's The Woman in Cabin 10 , Knightley has become a natural fit for tense thrillers.
